scope: restaurants, pubs, cafes, pop-ups and markets
row_rule: a post counts as a listing when it names a date; it becomes a row when one venue-night carries a usable detail (a time, a price, or what is on). date_inferred means a weekday was resolved against the post's own publish date. needs_check means the evidence is a search snippet or an inferred date.

platform_coverage.note: Those five networks have no ScrapeCreators endpoint and return HTTP 404. Facebook has no keyword search, so its pages and groups are found via Google and read directly.
